name: The Kept Wall

levels.entry: Dry stone round a shoulder of the range, enclosing a hollow with nothing in it.
The wall is a course or two higher than weather would have left it. Somebody has been putting stones back.
There is no path to it. The grass at the foot is not grown over, which means it is walked and not often.
The gate has been closed with newer stone, laid from the inside.
A wall in repair around an empty place, and the people at the rail-head will talk about the ore all day and go quiet about this. I have not asked twice.

notes: Aravali. Deliberately unresolved at the last rung -- the diary describes exactly and refuses to guess, which is the discipline this game is about.
